ops.en: not authorized, valid, justified, or permitted by law, rules, or accepted standards
ops.cn: 未经授权的；无效的；不正当的；不合法的

ops.en: dated/sensitive: born to parents not legally married to each other, or historically not recognized as lawful by marriage rules
ops.cn: （旧式/敏感）非婚生的；历史上按婚姻规则未被视为合法的
ops.usage_note: Avoid using illegitimate as a stigmatizing label for a person.

ops.en: forbidden by law, rules, or accepted standards; illegal or socially disapproved, especially of trade, activities, substances, or relationships
ops.cn: 违法的；被规则禁止的；不正当的

ops.en: famous, highly respected, and distinguished because of notable achievement or history
ops.cn: 著名而杰出的；享有盛誉的

ops.en: formal or literary: to drink, especially alcohol
ops.cn: （正式/文学）饮用；尤指饮酒

ops.en: figurative: to absorb or take in ideas, information, knowledge, or attitudes
ops.cn: （比喻）吸收、接受思想、信息、知识或观念

ops.en: to fill, permeate, or strongly influence someone or something with a quality, feeling, idea, or color
ops.cn: 使充满；使浸透；使深受某种品质、情感、思想或颜色影响

ops.meaning_cn: 使某物/某人充满某种品质、情感或思想

ops.en: living or lasting forever, or remembered and admired for a very long time
ops.cn: 不朽的；永生的；永远被铭记的

ops.en: a person whose fame or work is remembered for generations
ops.cn: 名垂青史的人；不朽人物

ops.en: flawless, faultless, or of an exceptionally high standard
ops.cn: 无可挑剔的；完美无瑕的；水准极高的

ops.value: The older theological sense 'incapable of sin' is specialist/historical and should not organize learner Core.

ops.meaning_cn: 驱使、推动某人走向某事物/方向

ops.en: rude or disrespectful, especially by being improperly bold or presumptuous
ops.cn: 无礼的；冒失放肆的；不敬的

ops.en: formal: not relevant or pertinent to the matter being considered
ops.cn: （正式）不相关的；离题的

ops.en: not allowing something to pass through, or not affected or influenced by something
ops.cn: 不渗透的；不受影响的；无动于衷的

ops.meaning_cn: 不受某物影响；对某物无动于衷/不可渗透

ops.en: acting or done quickly and impulsively without enough thought about the consequences
ops.cn: 冲动的；鲁莽急躁的；未经充分考虑的

ops.en: moving or acting with sudden violent force
ops.cn: 猛烈的；来势汹汹的

ops.en: to show or suggest that someone is involved in wrongdoing, or more generally to involve or imply something in a result or situation
ops.cn: 牵涉；显示某人卷入不当行为；也可泛指涉及或意味着某因素

ops.meaning_cn: （正式）纠缠、苦求某人给予某物
（正式）一再恳求或纠缠某人做某事

ops.en: impressive, grand, or commanding in appearance, size, or effect
ops.cn: 气势宏伟的；给人深刻印象的；威严的

ops.en: lack of power, ability, influence, or effectiveness to act or change a situation
ops.cn: 无力；无能为力；缺乏影响或效力

ops.en: medical/sexual: erectile dysfunction or inability to perform sexual intercourse
ops.cn: （医学/性健康）勃起功能障碍；性功能障碍

ops.en: rare/formal: to invoke, call down, or wish a curse or evil upon someone or something
ops.cn: （罕见/正式）诅咒；祈求灾祸降临于……

ops.en: rare/formal: to invoke or call down a curse or evil upon someone or something
ops.cn: （罕见/正式）诅咒；祈求灾祸降临于……

ops.en: done, said, or performed without advance preparation or planning
ops.cn: 即兴的；事先没有准备的

ops.en: without advance preparation; spontaneously
ops.cn: 即兴地；无准备地

ops.en: acting suddenly without enough forethought or self-control
ops.cn: 冲动的；未经充分考虑就行动的

ops.en: formal: to attribute responsibility, fault, motive, cause, or a quality to someone or something
ops.cn: （正式）把责任、过错、动机、原因或性质归于……

ops.meaning_cn: 把责任、过错、动机或性质归于某人/某物

ops.en: unintentional; happening because of lack of attention rather than deliberate choice
ops.cn: 无意的；非故意的；疏忽造成的

ops.en: not alive; not having life
ops.cn: 无生命的；非生物的

ops.note: Linguistics: an inanimate noun denotes a nonliving thing.

ops.en: to make a person, system, or thing unable to function, act, or work normally, temporarily or permanently
ops.cn: 使失去能力；使无法正常行动、工作或运转

ops.en: to disable seriously through illness or injury, sometimes permanently
ops.cn: 因疾病或伤害使严重失能

ops.en: continuing without stopping, often for a long time or in an annoying way
ops.cn: 不停的；持续不断的；没完没了的

ops.en: minor, secondary, or not central to the main purpose
ops.cn: 次要的；附带的；非主要的

ops.en: occurring as a chance accompaniment, by-product, or consequence; often incidental to something
ops.cn: 偶然伴随的；作为附带结果发生的

ops.meaning_cn: 附带于某事；相对于某事是次要的

ops.note: Noun/plural incidentals: small extra items or expenses.

ops.en: clear, sharp, intelligent, and direct in analysis, thought, or comment
ops.cn: 敏锐的；深刻而直接的；一针见血的

ops.note: Literal/specialist: suitable for cutting or piercing.

ops.en: to provoke, encourage, or stir people to take action, especially violent, unlawful, or disorderly action
ops.cn: 煽动；鼓动；刺激采取行动，尤指暴力或违法行动

ops.meaning_cn: 与某物不相容、不兼容或不一致

ops.en: impossible or extremely difficult to imagine, believe, or understand
ops.cn: 不可想象的；难以置信的；无法设想的

ops.en: to keep eggs, cells, microorganisms, or other developing material under conditions that allow growth or development
ops.cn: 孵化；培养；使在适宜条件下发育

ops.en: figurative: to develop an idea, plan, or project gradually before putting it into practice
ops.cn: （比喻）酝酿、培育想法或计划

ops.en: for a disease or infection to develop during an incubation period before symptoms appear
ops.cn: （疾病/感染）处于潜伏、发展期

ops.en: to teach or impress an idea, value, attitude, or habit persistently, especially through repeated instruction
ops.cn: 反复灌输思想、价值观、态度或习惯

ops.meaning_cn: 向某人反复灌输某种思想、价值观或习惯

ops.en: impossible to remove, erase, or forget, literally or figuratively
ops.cn: 擦不掉的；不可磨灭的；难以忘怀的

ops.en: to set a line of text inward from the margin
ops.cn: 使文本缩进；从页边向内排

ops.en: a notch, recess, or inward space in an edge or surface; also a text indentation
ops.cn: 凹口；凹痕；缩进

ops.en: originating, naturally occurring, or native to a particular place; for peoples, having ancestral ties to a region before later settlement or colonization
ops.cn: 本土的；土生土长的；原住民的

ops.value: When referring to Indigenous peoples or identities, capitalize Indigenous where the relevant style convention requires it; ordinary biological/geographic indigenous may remain lowercase.
